Technology with a Dominican soul

One “hello”.
A whole country
to explore.

Ary is a robotic parrot that chats with visitors, bringing them closer to the places, flavours and stories of the Dominican Republic.

Ary image provided by the project team.

From “what shall we do now?” to “I want to go there”.

How she is built

Raspberry Pi 4
System computer.
4 servomotors
Robot movement.
A speaker
Audio output.
A microphone
Voice input.
A detection sensor
Detection built into the robot.

A conversation with Ary

The starting point is the visitor's interests: food, culture or nature. The experience aims to give them a new idea of what to discover.

Gemini + a trained model

Ary uses Gemini to converse. She also has a trained model that forms part of the project.

The website demo is guided and is not connected to the physical robot.

Dominican Republic · WRO project01 / Ary la Cotorra
aryThe project's evolution

From Don Rafael to Ary la Cotorra.

An earlier robotic doll made way for a new personality bringing Dominican culture closer to travellers.

Before / The first model

Don Rafael.

A doll with an Arduino and some sensors. This was the project's earlier stage.

Now / A new stage

Ary la Cotorra.

A parrot with a Raspberry Pi 4, four servomotors, a speaker, a microphone and a detection sensor. She uses Gemini to converse and has a trained model.

Ary's identity brings together her green and violet plumage, red forehead and pale beak.

The same desire to connect.
A new way to do it.

The opportunity

Explore a cultural experience in airports, restaurants and tourism venues. For an airline such as Arajet, the proposal is to connect the journey with the destination.

The next step

Define a possible pilot, its venue and its content. The website lets you prepare an information request.

Proposed settings. Installations, partnerships and commercial results are not presented as confirmed.
